implementation: Round 2 Recovery Manager rules (Sai Tarun Reddy Velagala), rebuilt for Round 3 on the organisers' fee-report schema by Anshul Nautiyal. Deterministic rules, no model call: one check per fee line (charge_<line_id>), reads all previous evidence with the latest override applied, claims only where evidence contradicts a charge, never on SILENT. See agents/recovery/README.md and PROVENANCE.md.
notes: No API key and no network needed. Fee lines come from data/sample/fee_report_sample.csv (organiser sample, dummy values). Offline replay: python -m agents.recovery.replay. Open findings F-07 to F-12: the side taken is in agents/recovery/policy.py and docs/decisions.md (D-RC01 onwards).
